  {"step":6,"file":"glib/guri.c","function":"parse_host","line":451,"var":"decoded","code":"if (g_hostname_is_non_ascii (decoded)) { host = g_hostname_to_ascii (decoded); ... }","note":"Non-ASCII hostnames are converted to ASCII, which can expand or transform the decoded bytes."},
  {"step":7,"file":"glib/guri.c","function":"uri_decoder","line":270,"var":"s[1],s[2]","code":"c = HEXCHAR (s);","note":"Percent sequences are interpreted by reading the two bytes after '%' without an explicit bounds check at this sink site."}

print(p.read_text())
